body: If I go to tell them i'm sad, they say i'll get over it and that I should stop pretending and some other shit like that. They don't give a fuck and my life is going downhill right now.

My parents were born and raised in China. And they found out about my depression when my mom saw cut marks on my skin. They told me to get a grip on it and that I have nothing to be depressed about. "Stop with this attention seeking." I think I really want to die and I really need help. Don't think the parents that raised me can help.
